notes.title: Update to Version2.0, Full Local Deployment AI chat model and high-quality TTS
notes.content:
[h2]New Support:[/h2]
[h3]• Add Support DeepSeek R1,and with "Think" part skip during TTS.[/h3]
[h3]• Add GPT-SoVITS2 Modified Optimized Edition:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3-second voice cloning for custom voice creation and support  Steam Workshop.
[*] GPU acceleration (NVIDIA cards) for near-instant (<1s) text-to-speech.
[*] Fully local deployment and offline running 
[/list]
[h3]• Add FastTTS Millisecond-Level TTS Engine:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Supports Kokoro and 800+ anime characters voicebanks.
[*] Genuine English accent voice models.
[*] NVIDIA GPU acceleration for ultra-fast real-time TTS.
[*] Seconds-level response even on CPU-only systems.
[*] Fully local deployment and offline running 
[/list]
[h3]• TurboKokoro Multilingual Engine:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Supported languages: Chinese, Japanese, English, French, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish.
[*] 54 built-in vocalists.
[*] Super-fast speed and natural pronunciation.
[*] Fully local deployment and offline running 
[/list]

[h2]Performance Improvements:[/h2]
[h3]• Reduced rendering compatibility issues.[/h3]
[h3]• Fixed character rendering issues.[/h3]

[h2]UI Enhancements:[/h2]
[h3]• Added right-bottom progress indicator for local LLM/TTS Engine loading.[/h3]
[h3]• Click "Details" to view voice engine logs.[/h3]

[h2]Deprecation:[/h2]
[h3]• Removed SuperVITS support; automatically replaced by GPT-SoVITS2.[/h3]

notes.title: Add support for ChatGPT compatible APIs
notes.content:
Add support for ChatGPT compatible APIs. 
Any LLM APIs in ChatGPT API format can be compatible and supported, and support Function call.
